question: Should OpenClaw continue the core Claws export creation path as part of the Claws RFC stack once the CLI registration and proof gaps are fixed?
rationale: This is a new user-facing Claw creation/export surface stacked on an unmerged lifecycle base and protected by the maintainer label, so code review can identify blockers but cannot settle final product acceptance.

options.title: Continue the Claws export stack
options.body: Fix the root CLI registration, add root-path coverage and real behavior proof, then review this draft after the lifecycle base remains accepted.

options.title: Pause until lifecycle lands
options.body: Keep this draft paused until the apply/status/remove lifecycle stack is merged and the creation/export shape can be reviewed against settled behavior.

options.title: Defer export out of core
options.body: Close or redirect the creation/export command if maintainers decide Claw authoring should live outside core for now.

recommendation.title: Continue the Claws export stack
recommendation.body: Fix the root CLI registration, add root-path coverage and real behavior proof, then review this draft after the lifecycle base remains accepted.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the current Claws export and lifecycle stack and are best positioned to answer whether this creation surface should continue in core.
